meta.name: oalders-playwright
meta.description: Playwright: read-only shared host Chromium bundle, browser IPC shared-memory, and the Chromium ProcessSingleton AF_UNIX socket bind under the MCP's short TMPDIR base (/tmp/claude-1000/pw-mcp, set by the installer/playwright-mcp.sh npx wrapper; nono blocks bind() by default, so a bundled-chromium launch dies without it)
